ma.compressImage(Object object)

Compress images. The compression quality is optional.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
src String Yes Image path, which can be a local path or code package path. (The simulator supports only a code package path.The code package path is case sensitive.)
quality Number 80 No Compression quality. The value ranges from 0 to 100. A smaller value indicates lower quality and higher compression rate (valid only for JPG files).
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String compressImage:ok
tempFilePath String Temporary path for storing compressed images (local path).

Sample Code

ma.compressImage({
  src: '', // Image path.
  quality: 80 // Compression quality.
});
